target.title: fix(nodes): resolve Unicode browser node names when configured by display name
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Browser gateway requests could fail to select a browser-capable node by display name when the node name used canonically equivalent Unicode text, such as composed and decomposed accented characters. The Browser gateway needs to agree with the shared node resolver instead of treating visually identical names as different keys.

## Why This Change Was Made
The shared node-name normalizer now canonicalizes names to NFC before applying the existing lowercase and Unicode letter/number folding. Browser gateway node selection continues to go through the shared resolver, and the resolver preserves compact display-name selectors as lower-priority matches so persisted selectors such as `MacStudio` still match `Mac Studio` without outranking exact display-name matches.

## User Impact
Users can target browser nodes by Unicode display names without needing to copy a node id or IP address. Existing configured browser node selectors that omit spaces or punctuation continue to resolve after the gateway switches to the shared matcher.

## Evidence
- Claim proved at `8caf3de856fcae11408f77ed242de0bf6a258917`: composed and decomposed Unicode node names now normalize to the same key, punctuation-only queries still stay unknown, compact display-name selectors remain below exact display-name matches, and `browser.request` routes a compact Unicode browser node selector through the shared resolver to the connected node proxy.
- Focused tests after merging latest `upstream/main`: `$env:PNPM_CONFIG_MODULES_DIR='E:/code/openclaw/node_modules'; node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/shared/node-match.test.ts extensions/browser/src/gateway/browser-request.profile-from-body.test.ts` passed with 2 Vitest shards and 21 tests passing.
- Browser gateway regression: `extensions/browser/src/gateway/browser-request.profile-from-body.test.ts` exercises `browserHandlers["browser.request"]` with `gateway.nodes.browser.node = "Café01"`, connected display name `Café 01`, and observes `nodeRegistry.invoke` using `nodeId: "cafe-node"` with `command: "browser.proxy"`.
- Runtime resolver proof: `node --import file:///E:/code/openclaw/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs --input-type=module -` imported `src/shared/node-match.ts` from this head and returned `{"normalized":"café-01","exact":"cafe-exact","compact":"cafe-compact"}` for decomposed `Cafe + U+0301` display names queried with composed `é`.
- Diff hygiene: `git diff --check -- src/shared/node-match.ts src/shared/node-match.test.ts extensions/browser/src/gateway/browser-request.profile-from-body.test.ts` passed.
